description: Assign an Amazon shipping template and/or a handling time (the most days from order to dispatch, lead_time_to_ship_max_days) to ONE product, model or category (name exactly one id). Inherited like Amazon field values: a category's value is the default of every product in it, a model's is shared by every colour and size, a product's overrides both. The template is given by id or name from list_amazon_shipping_templates and is refused, with the available ones, when it is not one of that store's templates. The handling time is refused when the product type does not take it. null removes a value so the level below shows through; omit a field to leave it as it is. Saved in the CRM only: a new listing and an offer on an existing ASIN carry them, and update_amazon_listing_content with part shipping (dry run first with preview_amazon_listing_content) sends them to an offer already on Amazon, under the owner's content arming. With no template assigned nothing is sent and Amazon applies the account's default shipping settings; with no handling time Amazon keeps its own default. Merchant-fulfilled offers only — an FBA offer takes neither. Values are stored per language, so two stores sharing one (UK and Ireland) read the same template id and skip it where it is not listed; alsoReadBy names them. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

categoryId.description: Assign on this CATEGORY — the default for every product in it.

handlingDays.description: Handling time: the most days between the order and dispatch (lead_time_to_ship_max_days). null removes it so the level below shows through. Omit to leave it as it is. Amazon's dry run (preview_amazon_listing_content) judges the limit of the product type.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Omit for the main store. Templates exist per store.

modelId.description: Assign on this MODEL — shared by every colour and size of it.

templateId.description: The shipping template: its id or its name from list_amazon_shipping_templates. null removes it so the level below shows through. Omit to leave it as it is.

name: set_amazon_shipping
title: Set Amazon shipping template and handling time
